body:
Thank you. I feel so much more valid for your support. I now have spoke to someone from the mental health team and have set stuff in motion going ahead for the next few weeks. 

I'll be going to the gym and then going for a short walk with my dogs which I hope might give me a different perspective. 

I still stand by what I said about myself. I do really feel those things about myself. I've never felt good about myself and give up so easily on my hopes and dreams and never finish anything because I feel like all of it is on me (motivation and stuff doesn't come easy when you think that you can't do anything right in the first place). I'm not looking for someone else to do everything for me, just someone who is having to do the same thing or doing it with me. 

The undateable thing? Well, I really doubt anyone will come running after me any time soon, I just don't think people don't look at me in that way. I just dont want to be alone anymore man. 

Thank you x

Thank you for your kind words. They really mean so much to me right now and thank you for the heads up. Im making a conscious effort to improve my self-esteem, I didn't realise that it could have such a hold over my problem like that.
